raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The DE-398 refactor on 2026-01-16 made silver_transactions derive txn_date from ingest_ts (which lands the day after the transaction) instead of txn_ts. All 4630 POSTED rows are therefore dated one day late. Deriving txn_date from txn_ts fixes silver, and the gold tables that group by txn_date follow.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.93, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
